t: On repeating what you have not checked
a: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْبَصَرَ وَٱلْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْـُٔولًا
p: Wa lā taqfu mā laysa laka bihi ʿilm, inna-s-samʿa wa-l-baṣara wa-l-fu'āda kullu ulā'ika kāna ʿanhu mas'ūlā.
m: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
